text: D206738 mkmelin requested deterministic queue completion instead of a 30-second timeout: a prior client might still write to the Inbox. They requested names _connectionWaitingQueue, _busyConnections, and onFree to match other protocols. In a two-account profile with a self-signed certificate, they found onFree and URL-listener TypeErrors. They asked to remove comments about prior code and F5, and temporary debug dumps. The revised patch was accepted.
